SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE
HARROWGATE FAMILY REVOCABLE LIVING TRUST

THIS SECOND AMENDMENT is made on July 2, 2026 by Eleanor Margaret Harrowgate, of Multnomah County, Oregon (the "Settlor"), to the Harrowgate Family Revocable Living Trust dated March 14, 2011, as amended by a First Amendment dated August 30, 2018 (as amended, the "Trust").

RECITALS

A. The Settlor created the Trust as settlor and served, and continues to serve, as the initial Trustee.

B. Article Twelve of the Trust reserves to the Settlor the right to amend or revoke the Trust in whole or in part at any time during the Settlor's lifetime, by a signed writing delivered to the then-serving Trustee.

C. The Settlor wishes to amend the Trust as set out below.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Settlor amends the Trust as follows:

1. ARTICLE FIVE — SUCCESSOR TRUSTEES

Article Five of the Trust is deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following:

"ARTICLE FIVE — SUCCESSOR TRUSTEES

5.1 On the Settlor's death, resignation, or incapacity, the following shall serve as successor Trustee, in the order named: first, the Settlor's daughter Imogen Harrowgate-Reyes; second, the Settlor's son Callum Harrowgate; and third, Cascadia Fiduciary Trust Company, a corporate fiduciary authorized to act in Oregon.

5.2 A Trustee is incapacitated when two licensed physicians, at least one of whom is a board-certified neurologist or psychiatrist not related to the Trustee by blood or marriage, certify in writing that the Trustee is unable to manage the Trust's affairs. Any successor Trustee may act on that certification without a court order, and the certifying physicians are released from any liability under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 and 45 C.F.R. Parts 160 and 164 for that disclosure.

5.3 No successor Trustee is liable for any act or omission of a predecessor, and no successor Trustee has a duty to examine the accounts or acts of a predecessor."

2. ARTICLE SEVEN — DISTRIBUTION ON THE SETTLOR'S DEATH

Section 7.3 of the Trust is deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following:

"7.3 The residue of the Trust Estate shall be divided into equal shares, one share for each of the Settlor's then-living children and one share for the then-living descendants, per stirpes, of any child who does not survive the Settlor. The share set aside for the Settlor's son Callum Harrowgate shall be held in a separate trust, and the Trustee shall distribute income and principal to him for his health, education, maintenance, and support, in the Trustee's discretion, until he attains the age of forty (40), at which time the remaining principal shall be distributed to him outright."

3. NEW ARTICLE FIFTEEN — DIGITAL ASSETS

The Trust is amended by adding the following as a new Article Fifteen:

"ARTICLE FIFTEEN — DIGITAL ASSETS

15.1 The Trustee has the power to access, control, transfer, and dispose of the Settlor's digital assets and electronic communications, and to obtain the content of electronic communications, as the Oregon Revised Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act, ORS 130.800 to 130.830, permits.

15.2 The Settlor's direction in this Article overrides any contrary provision in a custodian's terms of service, and the Settlor consents to the disclosure of the content of electronic communications to the Trustee."

4. RATIFICATION

Except as expressly amended by this Second Amendment, the Trust remains in full force and effect and is ratified and confirmed in all respects. All references in the Trust to "this Trust" mean the Trust as amended by the First Amendment and by this Second Amendment.

5. GOVERNING LAW

This Second Amendment and the Trust are governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Settlor has executed this Second Amendment on the date first written above.

/s/ Eleanor Margaret Harrowgate
Eleanor Margaret Harrowgate, Settlor
